programs.title: Embarrassing Bodies
programs.desc: Dr. Christian Jessen and his team of doctors help people suffering from rare and very embarrassing diseases.In this series, medics will face really difficult challenges.

programs.title: Embarrassing Bodies: Revisits
programs.desc: Dr. Jessen and his team will learn about the condition of their former patients.

programs.title: Inside Dubai: Playground of the Rich
programs.desc: The luxurious life of millionaires and billionaires living in the tax haven of the United Arab Emirates.The creators of the documentary also present profiles of people who serve as their servants.

programs.title: The First Class Travel Show
programs.desc: Presenter Josie Gibson embarks on a unique adventure during which she experiences the highest levels of comfort and elegance.Her journey is full of exclusive attractions and luxurious amenities.

programs.title: Inside Monaco: Playground of the Rich
programs.desc: The history of the principality where the most millionaires in the world live.The producers look behind the scenes of the royal palace and follow the life of Prince Albert II, who rules this unique country.

programs.title: 10 Ways to Lose 10 Years
programs.desc: Image experts will share their knowledge about fashion and beauty.Thanks to them, viewers will see that you can look beautiful at any age.A few tricks will make anyone feel younger.
